verdict.rationale: Cursor's own documentation describes launching fleets of agents in parallel on long-running tasks. Cloud Agents run in isolated VMs, you can run as many as you want in parallel, and they do not need your local machine to stay connected. Fleets can be launched and managed programmatically through the Cloud Agents API and SDK. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-hour/multi-day runs, documented detail on runtime limits backing the 'hours or days' claim (currently a marketing-page statement).

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can launch fleets of autonomous agents that work in parallel on different tasks for hours or days

citations.quote: Launch fleets of agents that work in parallel on ambitious tasks for hours or days.
You can run as many agents as you want in parallel, and they do not require your local machine to be connected to the internet.
The Cloud Agents API lets you programmatically launch and manage cloud agents that work on your repositories.
